root_cause: When the drawer is opened via the button, focus remains on the triggering button instead of moving inside the drawer, preventing keyboard users from interacting with the filter controls.
repair_strategy: Override the Drawer.show method to focus the close button (#filters-close) after the drawer is shown, ensuring initial focus is placed within the drawer for keyboard navigation.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus moves into the drawer when opened, allowing sequential tab navigation to the filter controls and apply button without requiring a pointing device.
functional_risks: If the element with id 'filters-close' is removed or becomes non‑focusable, focus will not be moved.
Overriding show may interfere with subclasses that rely on the original show timing.
verification_requirements: After activating the Filters button with Enter, focus is on #filters-close.
Pressing Tab twice moves focus to #apply.
Pressing Enter on #apply updates the applied output to 'in' and hides the drawer.
